name: workbar
description: A live progress bar with honest time estimates, subagent tracking, chat-size and prompt-cache health with one-press Compact or Hand off, files-changed list, and desktop/phone alerts. Uses almost no tokens.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: auto: show the band only when there is something to see or do (a plan, agents, files changed, a warning); the chat size then lives in the status line. always: also show the chat-size gauge between tasks. off: status line only.

progressTool.title: Ask Claude for a progress plan
progressTool.description: On: Claude reports steps and an estimate through a tiny tool (about 150 cached tokens per request, a few dozen per task). Off: no tokens at all; the bar then follows Claude's own todo list when it keeps one.

holdMessages.title: Hold a message into an oversized or cold chat
holdMessages.description: Before a message goes into a very large chat, or a large one whose prompt cache has expired, hold it once and offer Compact or Hand off. Pressing Enter again sends it anyway.

topicCheck.title: Spot a new task in a long chat
topicCheck.description: In chats over 60k tokens, ask Haiku whether a new message is a different task and suggest a fresh chat. Costs one small model call (a few hundred tokens) per such message.

amberTokens.title: Chat size: amber at
amberTokens.description: Tokens at which the band suggests finishing the current task in this chat.

redTokens.title: Chat size: red at
redTokens.description: Tokens at which the band recommends Compact or Hand off before sending more.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto: 1 hour on a Claude subscription, 5 minutes otherwise (or your promptCacheTtl setting).

notify.title: Desktop alerts
notify.description: Pop-ups when Claude needs your approval, has waited 15 s on a question, or finishes a long run. Windows uses a native toast; elsewhere your terminal's notifications.

notifyAfterSeconds.title: Alert when a run takes longer than (seconds)
notifyAfterSeconds.description: A run that finishes after at least this long sends a 'Finished' alert.

pushUrl.title: Phone alerts (ntfy URL)
pushUrl.description: Optional. An ntfy topic URL such as https://ntfy.sh/your-secret-topic: the same alerts reach your phone. Only the alert text is sent. Empty: off.

activityDir.title: Activity marker folder
activityDir.description: Optional. A folder where each session writes a <session>.txt file reading 'busy <ms>' or 'idle <ms>', for your own scripts (for example: sleep the machine once Claude is done). Empty: off.
